# SquarePic

> SquarePic provides free image editing tools and social media size guides. Photos are processed locally in the browser without server uploads or account registration.

This file helps AI tools find SquarePic pages. It does not control search indexing or replace robots.txt and XML sitemaps. SquarePic uses analytics; see the privacy policy for details.

## Image tools

- [Square image editor](https://www.squarepic.io/): Add blur or color backgrounds, crop, and resize photos.
- [Image compressor](https://www.squarepic.io/compressor): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP files, individually or in batches.
- [Image converter](https://www.squarepic.io/converter): Convert image formats and download results.
- [Photo cropper](https://www.squarepic.io/cropper): Crop with aspect ratio presets, zoom, and pan.
- [Image upscaler](https://www.squarepic.io/upscaler): Enlarge photos with bicubic interpolation and sharpening.
- [Image size calculator](https://www.squarepic.io/image-size-calculator): Browse platform dimensions and aspect ratios.
